newsitem.title: USA: Covenant Transport CFO Molin to leave.
newsitem.headline: Covenant Transport CFO Molin to leave.

text.p: Covenant Transport Inc said Monday chief financial officer Bradley Moline will leave the company during the third quarter of 1997 to become chief financial officer of a midwestern telecommunications company.

Covenant said it will begin the search for a new chief financial officer immediately. In the interim, the company said existing management, including vice president of administration R.H. Lovin, will handle the CFO functions. Lovin was CFO prior to June 1994.
Covenant Transport is a long-haul truckload carrier.
